subject: attn
title: (R)ATTN.------AFI.
description: Chart on book p. 274 (PR.S(RD)II-28). ATTN (attraction) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; AFI (affinity insight) is the partner. From the subject: AF-DY (affinity dynamics), MT-INFO (multi-information) and ALT-FT (alternative functionalism). From AF-DY: VT-DY (vibrational dynamics). From VT-DY: AGT (agreement). From MT-INFO: INFO-F (information focus). From INFO-F: DEF (definition), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From ALT-FT: ACT (activism). From ACT: POL-CON (political consciousness). From POL-CON: EXT-FT (extended functionalism).
